title: Derived mate and the underived sections map
statement: Let f:X→S be any scheme morphism, s:Spec Ω→S a geometric point, K∈D⁺(Ab(X_et)), n∈ℤ, J a bounded-below complex of injective abelian etale sheaves on X and q:K≅Q(ιJ). Put M=ιJ and L=f_*M; identify Rf_*K with QL by sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison]. For every pointed neighbourhood i, the composite of strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-localized-hom-germ], global sections of H^n of the derived mate, and strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data] equals H^n of the chain map obtained by applying strictLocalUnderivedMateSections f s i degreewise [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-underived-sections-mate], followed by the inverse localization/homology factorization and representativeSectionsComparison for p:X×_S S_(s)→X [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison]. No neighbourhood cone geometry is chosen and no identification of the underived map with cone restriction is asserted.

proof.text: Put M=ιJ and apply Adjunction.derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac to the two inverse/direct-image adjunctions, the underived squareUpperStarIso and pullbackSquareComparison. The hypothesis identifying the square on complexes is pullbackSquareComparison_hom_app_factorsh (WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.DerivedComparison). Invert the direct-image derived unit on M, which is allowed for the fixed bounded-below injective representative and is exactly the unit factor in sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso. The result expresses the derived mate by the underived mate followed by the derived direct-image unit at p^*M.

Move restriction on the base through the derived units using their naturality. Apply global sections on S_(s); they are exact. Expand strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso as the exact-sections homology isomorphism followed by the derived Leray isomorphism. The defining factorization of derived composition changes the direct-image unit at p^*M followed by Leray into the derived-sections unit at p^*M. Keep this unit as a morphism: it is not inverted. All underived factors are now restriction on S followed by baseChangeMap and lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso, the definition of strictLocalUnderivedMateSections. No assertion of the theorem identifying that map with cone restriction is used.

Apply localization and degree-n homology to the factorization, commute the exact-sections comparison by naturality, and transport by q. The homologyFunctorFactors inverse is the initial localization comparison; the surviving sections unit transported by q is representativeSectionsComparison. This is the displayed formula. The argument works in every integer degree, including zero complexes, without assuming p^*M injective or acyclic.

theorem strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction_derivedMate {X S : Scheme.{v}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (n : ℤ)
    (J : CochainComplex.Plus (InjectiveObject
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})))
    (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) :
    ∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
    let M := ((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj
    let L := ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction s
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) L
      (sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso f K J q) n i ≫
        ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map
          ((mateEquiv (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).derivedPlus
            (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).derivedPlus
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f
                (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).toCommSq).hom))
                |>.natTrans.app K))) ≫
        (strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso f s K n).hom =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (.up ℤ) n).map
      ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (strictLocalUnderivedMateSections f s i)
        (.up ℤ)).app M) ≫
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).inv.app _ ≫
    representativeSectionsComparison
      (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) q n
